description.value: Flourish BeauTea is a Victoria-based bakery specializing in handcrafted custom cakes and cupcakes made to order with fresh, local ingredients, offered in flavours ranging from matcha to purple yam to passionfruit. The business operates from both a Victoria Downtown location on Fort Street and a Langford location, and also runs hands-on cake workshops. For a touring cyclist, it is a distinctive local stop for a sweet treat or a unique edible souvenir.
